nameEn: Retail sale of music and video recordings in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of music and video recordings in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of recorded music: CDs, vinyl records, cassette tapes
retail sale of video recordings: DVDs, Blu-ray discs, video tapes
retail sale of blank recording media
excludes: retail sale of video game equipment and software, see 4764
